newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mid-Atlantic spot electricity flat to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mid-Atlantic spot electricity flat to lower.

text.p: Spot electricity prices in the midsection of the eastern seaboard were flat to lower Wednesday compared with Tuesday's levels, market sources said.
"It's getting back to levels where we were trading late last week," said one East Coast trader.

Physical electricity values in the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (PJM) Interconnect power pool remained pressured by cool weather and return of several coal-fired generating stations this week, they said.

Currently, at least three PJM power plants, with total capacity close to 1,800 megawatt (MW), were expected to return to service in the next 24 hours after being shut last weekend for repairs or maintenance.
GPU Generation said its 600 MW, coal-fired Homer City, Pa., unit 1 and 850 MW coal-fired Conemaugh unit 2 also in Pennsylvania were expected to start producing power Wednesday.
Potomac Electric Co's 341 MW, coal-fired Chalk Point 1 unit was scheduled to be back in operation Thursday.
"That may drive the prices down more," said one PJM trader.
Firm electricity prices for heavy load hours on Thursday in PJM were quoted at $20.00-$20.50, down from Tuesday's range of $21.00-$21.75. Next-day PJM deals were heard done at $20.50.
PJM electricity for the rest of the week was discussed between $20.50 and $21.50, off from Tuesday's $21.00-$22.00 quote.
PJM power for the balance of September was quoted at $20.25-$21.00.
Peak, firm PJM power for October was assessed at $20.40-$20.50, with a unconfirmed deal at $21.40. Tuesday's value for October PJM was pegged at $20.50-$20.65.
November PJM was quoted at $21.75-$21.95, with unconfirmed deals at $21.80. Today's quote was flat from Tuesday.
December PJM was assessed at $25.70-$25.90, unchanged from Tuesday's range.
PJM electricity delivery in the 1996 fourth quarter was quoted at $22.50-$22.65, slightly firmer than Tuesday's assessment of $22.40-$22.60.
January/February 1997 PJM power was valued at $29.20-$29.35, flat from Tuesday's level.
First-quarter 1997 PJM delivery was discussed at $27.30-$27.70, unchanged from Tuesday's quote.
